episodes.title: The Myth of the House
episodes.summary: Refaat's old flame Maggie returns from Scotland, and he reluctantly invites her to a party in honor of his birthday. A sighting exacerbates the tension.

episodes.title: The Myth of the Curse of the Pharaoh
episodes.summary: After a supposedly cursed mummy is autopsied, a black cloud looms over Cairo. Refaat refuses to believe they're linked — until a loved one is affected.

episodes.title: The Myth of the Guardian of The Cave
episodes.summary: When all fails, Refaat and Maggie search for a cure in the Libyan Desert. Joined by their ex-colleague, they must first get past a mythical creature.

episodes.title: The Myth of the Naiad
episodes.summary: After an alarming tarot reading, Refaat visits his hometown to resolve a family emergency. As he jumps to the rescue, an alluring voice hypnotizes him.

episodes.title: The Myth of the Incubus
episodes.summary: Overcome with grief, Refaat's health deteriorates. Convinced that Shiraz is behind all tragedies, he chases her around a haunted maze in his dreams.

episodes.title: The Myth of the House: The Return
episodes.summary: Refaat uses his brain's faculties to decipher the real story behind Shiraz's death, taking him back to where it all began.The third tarot card is shown.
